name: Jerrod Weston
biography: Jerrod Weston is an International actor. The son of Suzanne Rosbach and Bruce Weston, he grew up in the rural suburbs of Seattle, Washington. Jerrod earned his first featured character in The Misfits and has since gone on to star in Nowadays with major supporting roles in The Color of Pomegranate, Bandirma Rocket Club, Akif, and i-Mania. He is also a screenwriter who co-created the sitcom Shameless Comedy. Jerrod is married to his elementary school classmate, International News Anchor Rachael Ruble. He also helped launch the premium tea brand Papp's Tea in China as General Manager and Minority Partner, as well as the Istanbul Comedy Club and Continental Comedy Circle in Turkey.
